flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui components/datagrid/column/index.tsx (columns vehicle_no, suspension_type, suspension_reason, payment_status), pages/NoticeSearch/list/{NoticeSearchAllList,NoticeSearchOutstandingList,NoticeValidList}, page/upload/UploadResult. ocmsadminapi: data from POST /validoffencenoticelist. Other repos not relevant
note: Status in stories.json: Fully paid, 1 point. Vehicle number and the main notice details (stage, date, rule code, amount, current offender) appear in all lists. 'Existing suspension details' are only Suspension Type and Reason for Suspension, and only in All mode and in the upload result; the Outstanding-mode list has no suspension column at all, and the suspension date, remarks and due date of revival are not shown in these lists. Ticket OCMS-DF-2026-187 (Pending UAT Verification) reports that the Payment Status column used suspensionType as its sort source; on main the source is now crsReasonOfSuspension (column/index.tsx:272), so the fix is visible in code but its UAT status cannot be verified from the repo.
recommendation: Claim partially: the summary includes the vehicle number, but suspension details are only type and reason, and absent in Outstanding mode.

steps.step: Searched notices are shown with vehicle number and the main notice details
steps.detail: Both search result lists contain the Vehicle No. column (column/index.tsx:228-233), notice no., stage, offence date, rule code, amount payable, current offender and court date (NoticeSearchAllList.tsx:140-172; NoticeSearchOutstandingList.tsx:160-182).

steps.step: The list shows existing suspension details (if any)
steps.detail: All mode and the upload result include the Suspension Type and Reason for Suspension (eprReasonOfSuspension) columns plus Payment Status (column/index.tsx:242-283; NoticeSearchAllList.tsx:162-166; NoticeValidList.tsx:56-61). That is all: suspension date, remarks and due date of revival are not in these lists (a due_date_of_revival column is defined in column/index.tsx but not used here). The Outstanding-mode list has no suspension column at all (NoticeSearchOutstandingList.tsx:160-182). Ticket OCMS-DF-2026-187 (Pending UAT Verification) about sorting Payment Status: the column source on main is already crsReasonOfSuspension (:272); UAT status cannot be verified from repo.

steps.step: Uploaded notices are shown as a summary with the key details
steps.detail: UploadResult.tsx:64-76 renders NoticeValidList with notice, notice type, offence date, place, rule code, stage, vehicle no., vehicle type, amount and court date columns (NoticeValidList.tsx:31-69). The suspension details in this list are judged in the previous step.
